text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Hafez al-Assad accepts an invitation to the Organisation of the Islamic Conference's summit to be held in Iran.
- Lebanese patriots destroy two Israeli tanks in south Lebanon.
- Syrian Prime Minister Mahmoud Zu'bi discusses cooperation with Lebanese minister of environment.
- Syrian Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara confers with European Union envoy Miguel Angel Moratinos over Middle East peace.
- Egypt reaffirms backing for the Syrian position in the peace talks.
- Israel plans to bring into the country 1.2 million Jews.

- Shara and Iranian Foreign Minister Velayati hold talks on bilateral ties and regional developments. Shara condemns the U.S. veto against a draft resolution to halt Jewish housing Arab East Jerusalem.
